versions.summary: First release: 11 graph steps (one-particle QM to the neutrino-mass frontier) and a synthesis step.
Adds Step 12, the final clustered view: the model layer grouped into the five Standard-Model Lagrangian terms, with the effective nodes of Steps 6-8 absorbed inside the gauge-fermion term.

Adds the method-in-action synthesis view (Step 13): the scientific-method cycle with the phases of each step filled, a compact schematic of the whole graph re-laid out step by step with the structural operations highlighted, and a per-step log of graph operations (added to the data as phases/ops).
